## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List checks actually run, including browser verification for UI changes.

## Release impact

State NONE, PATCH, MINOR, or MAJOR based on the behavior change. Describe migration steps for breaking changes.

## Review notes

Mention material AI assistance, known limits, and any privacy or stored-data implications. Confirm that no private browsing data, credentials, or signing keys are included.
